## Problem

Who is blocked today, and what do they have to do instead?

## Proposal

What ForiFlow should do instead. Name the screen or endpoint if you know it.

## Out of scope

Anything this request is *not* asking for (helps keep the PR small).

## Compliance / data

Does this need ECIB, customer PII, or an SBP audit trail? Say so up front.

## Success looks like

A concrete check a reviewer can run (example: "POST /ews/monitor with a 16-point drop creates an Active alert").
